name: S. I. Hayakawa
summary:
Samuel Ichiye Hayakawa (Japanese: 早川 一衛, July 18, 1906 – February 27, 1992) was a Canadian-born American academic and politician. A professor of English, he served as president of San Francisco State University and then as a U.S. Senator from California from 1977 to 1983.
Hayakawa was born in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, to Japanese immigrants.
